field_updates.detail: "Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage", Hyper Red, "Ta = 25 °C" (linear 0-50 mA vs 1.5-2.5 V). Read points: 0.81 mA @ 1.699 V (resid +6.6 mV); 1.34 mA @ 1.724 V (resid -3.5 mV); 1.88 mA @ 1.749 V (resid -1.6 mV); 3.22 mA @ 1.784 V (resid -4.6 mV); 5.10 mA @ 1.819 V (resid -3.7 mV); 6.15 mA @ 1.834 V (resid -3.0 mV); 6.95 mA @ 1.849 V (resid +2.2 mV); 8.29 mA @ 1.864 V (resid +2.7 mV); 9.91 mA @ 1.878 V (resid +2.0 mV); 12.06 mA @ 1.893 V (resid -0.4 mV); 14.71 mA @ 1.913 V (resid +0.8 mV); 17.39 mA @ 1.933 V (resid +4.0 mV); 20.08 mA @ 1.948 V (resid +3.8 mV); 25.15 mA @ 1.968 V (resid -1.9 mV); 29.95 mA @ 1.988 V (resid -3.7 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=1.944 V vs stated typ 1.95 V (-6 mV); "Forward Voltage IF = 20mA VF Hyper Red 1.95 2.5 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector polyline vertices (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from gridlines; vertices with I >= 0.8 mA used (current quantised at ~0.27 mA by the drawing, so sub-mA vertices dropped). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 15 points 0.81-30.0 mA, rms 3.3 mV. Window sensitivity: lower bound 0.8/1.3/2/5 mA gives N 2.54-3.17, RS 1.0-2.2 ohm. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
